title: WPMS/1562/2017 of Jeet Singh AND OTHERS Vs Deputy Director Consolidation/district Magistrate Udham Singh Nagar AND OTHERS

paras.text:
WPMS No. 1562 of 2017
U.C.Dhyani, J.
 Mr. Vikas Kumar Guglani, Advocate,
present for the writ petitioners.
 Mr. R.C.Arya, Standing Counsel, present
for the State.
 By means of present writ petition, the
petitioners pray for the following relief, among
others:
"Issue a writ, order or direction in the
nature of certiorari quashing and setting
aside the order dated 14.6.2017 passed by
respondent no.1."
 It is the submission of learned counsel for
the petitioners that in spite of being caveators,
they were not heard while the impugned order
was passed.
 Order impugned passed by the Deputy
Director of Consolidation/District Magistrate,
Udham Singh Nagar will reveal that despite the
caveat filed by the writ petitioners, they were
not heard and the order impugned was passed.
The Order under challenge, therefore, calls for
interference.
 Writ Petition is disposed of by setting
aside the order dated 14.06.2017 and directing
the Deputy Director of Consolidation/District
Magistrate, Udham Singh Nagar, to pass fresh
Order after hearing both the parties, in
accordance with law.
